The dune line meets both side edges at the same height so the join is invisible. No crystals, no gems, no rocks with color. Brief palette: sand #d9b27c, rock #a86f46, shadow violet #5a4a7a, sky peach #f2c49b and teal #3f7f8c; crystal colors ember red #e04a3a, verdant green #3fbf6a, gray #8c8c8c (crystal colors appear only on crystal pieces).
